rationale: unit:given.state maps empty/initialized slots to none/some ObjectId, with ObjectId = Nat. Object contains the class name and ordered named slots; State contains the object and variable lists plus nextId; State.empty has empty lists and counter zero. StoragePlace distinguishes a named variable from a named field of a particular object. Stored is membership in the appropriate list, so none denotes an existing empty slot and an absent entry has no lookup witness. State.create in the inspected Step context uses nextId and increments it. Distinctness describes the chapter's well-formed states, not a property built into the raw list-based State type; WellFormed in the inspected Soundness context supplies exactly those restrictions.
